name: John C. Breckinridge
desc: vice president of the United States from 1857 to 1861 (1821–1875)
summary: John Cabell Breckinridge (January 16, 1821 – May 17, 1875) was an American politician who served as the 14th vice president of the United States, with President James Buchanan, from 1857 to 1861. He then betrayed his oath, and served as a general in the Confederate Army during the American Civil War. Having assumed office at the age of 36, Breckinridge is the youngest vice president in U.S. history.
